name: Riley Luffsey
role: Hunter killed in 1883 in a fight involving the Marquis de Morès
bio: Riley Luffsey was a hunter killed at Little Missouri in 1883 when he and his companions met a party that included the Marquis de Morès. In 1885 the case was revived: Paddock and the Marquis were indicted for murder, Dick Moore and Frank Miller were later added, and the trial moved to Bismarck in September. The Cow Boy called Luffsey and Wannegan quiet, peaceable hunters who happened to be with O'Donald, while defense witnesses testified that Luffsey and O'Donald had threatened to shoot de Morès on sight, and a justice who had first heard the case said he discharged the Marquis on grounds of self-defense. In January 1886 a court hearing was set on Luffsey's estate.
